learningObjectives: Select and justify data validation against a pattern in a business scenario.
reviewScope: Official topic comparison and original-question editorial review; not vendor endorsement.

elements.description: An Edit Validate rule checks a property's character format. A Validate rule can enforce broader business conditions and call Edit Validate at submission. Built-in patterns may validate on field exit; custom Java Edit Validate logic executes server-side. A valid format does not establish that an identifier exists or belongs to the user.

elements.text: Worked example: An internal asset tag must match three letters followed by four digits. Check its pattern with Edit Validate, then separately check uniqueness or existence using application logic. Test valid, malformed, empty and boundary inputs.

elements.title: Training environment checklist
items: Implement the worked example in a training application; use synthetic data.
Test the expected path and at least one failure or boundary condition.
Explain why the alternative mechanism would not meet the requirement.
Revisit incorrect answers in Smart Review rather than memorizing option positions.

elements.text: These notes target the '25 exam. Shared Academy pages may show newer labels with '25 applicability; verify screens in your training environment.

examPitfalls.title: Pattern versus business truth
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Matching a format proves an identifier is genuine.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Separate syntax checks from existence and authorization.

examPitfalls.title: Timing
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Every custom Edit Validate rule executes in the browser.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Distinguish supported built-in client behavior from server-side custom logic.

practiceQuiz.scenario: An asset code must follow a fixed character pattern. Which rule is designed for this?
practiceQuiz.rationale: Edit Validate checks property formats. Packaging and process coordination do not validate character patterns.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A code passes its pattern check. Which conclusion is still unsupported?

options.text: The code exists in the authoritative register
The characters fit the configured format
The pattern rule accepted the input

practiceQuiz.rationale: Format validation checks syntax, not existence in a system of record or ownership.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A form must ensure its end date follows its start date. Which mechanism fits this cross-field business condition?
practiceQuiz.rationale: A Validate rule can express business conditions involving several fields. An Edit Validate pattern is focused on field format.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A Validate rule calls Edit Validate during submission. What does the Edit Validate still check?

options.text: The field's format, at submission time

practiceQuiz.rationale: Calling the format rule from broader validation changes when it runs, not its purpose.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which TWO should be included in a custom pattern validation test?

options.text: Malformed and boundary inputs that should be rejected

practiceQuiz.rationale: Positive and negative cases establish both acceptance and rejection behavior. Unrelated UI assets do not exercise the pattern.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Why should custom Java in an Edit Validate rule be reviewed carefully?

options.text: It creates an independent access group
It adds server-side code and potential security and maintenance risks

practiceQuiz.rationale: Custom code needs review and testing. Prefer an existing suitable pattern before implementing custom logic.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A select field must restrict values to a stable approved list. Which design can enforce this before a pattern is needed?

options.text: A controlled drop-down with approved values
Allow arbitrary text and trust the label
Create a new ruleset per submission

practiceQuiz.rationale: A constrained choice list can prevent invalid enumeration values. Pattern checks address different input requirements.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A built-in field pattern reports an error when the user tabs out. Does that eliminate the need to validate server-side processing paths?

options.text: Yes; all API clients necessarily run browser scripts
Only if the field name begins with py
No; submitted and non-browser paths still need appropriate validation

practiceQuiz.rationale: Client feedback improves usability but does not establish correctness for every path. Server processing must enforce its requirements.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.
